optimization.action_description: Split the scalar FP4 MoE into stage1 activation generation [T*top_k, I] and stage2 output accumulation [T, H].
optimization.expected_impact: Remove repeated W1 gate/up projection work across output hidden columns.
optimization.risks_and_rollback: Adds a temporary fp32 activation buffer and a second launch; rollback to v2 scalar single-kernel baseline if tiny shapes regress.

profile_evidence.evidence_summary: Smoke profile PASS on NVIDIA L20D: 505.4400us vs previous scalar 26201.7288us.
profile_evidence.evidence_chain: scalar baseline recomputed W1 gate/up for each output h -> staged kernel computes activation once per token/topk/intermediate -> W2 stage reuses mid buffer -> 51.84x faster on smoke profile
